info.title: Keeper API
info.description: API spec for Tacito Square Keeper component, managing agent configurations, communities, and support entities.

tags.name: agent-config/llm-bindings
tags.description: Bounded context: Agent Configuration · Model Bindings. Manages LLM provider registrations used by agents at runtime. Why: It decouples the specific LLM hosting details (endpoints, secure credentials) from the cognitive agent models, allowing system administrators to update, swap, or rotate provider credentials globally without changing agent definitions.

tags.name: agent-config/mcp-servers
tags.description: Bounded context: Agent Configuration · Tool Bindings. Manages Model Context Protocol (MCP) server profiles that expose tools to agents. Why: MCP standardizes how autonomous agents securely connect to external data sources, APIs, and local scripts. Exposing these profiles separates environment-specific tool execution from the core agent logic.

tags.name: agent-config/skills
tags.description: Bounded context: Agent Configuration · Skills. Defines skill collections and controls which tools an agent may use. Why: Restricts agent capabilities to pre-approved boundaries. Skills dictate how agents behave, what tools they can invoke, and what guidelines they must follow.

tags.name: agent-config/prompt-engineering
tags.description: Bounded context: Agent Configuration · Prompt Engineering. Manages versioned prompt templates and the collections that group them. Why: Decouples prompt iteration and cognitive instructions from the static code, allowing system behavior to be modified dynamically via REST APIs.

tags.name: agent-config/agents
tags.description: Bounded context: Agent Configuration · Templates. Manages agent templates used to deploy autonomous units at runtime. Why: Serves as the cognitive blueprint of an agent, combining its brain (LLM), memory policies, prompt templates, and active tools into a single deployment manifest.

tags.name: community/communities
tags.description: Bounded context: Community · Logical Boundaries. Manages logical networking, collaboration topology, and isolation domains for agents. Why: Ensures tenant isolation and defines how agents communicate with each other or coordinate work under specific topologies.

tags.name: lifecycle/management
tags.description: Bounded context: Lifecycle Management. Enables deploying, undeploying and monitoring active runtime agents and communities. Why: Bridges the logical configuration layer with Kubernetes runtime scheduling, managing the lifecycle of the actual agent containers.

tags.name: development/operations
tags.description: development supporting operations. Why: Exposes operational tools (such as echo/ping tests) to verify connectivity across architectural layers during development and staging.

post.summary: Create a new LLM provider binding

Location.description: The URI of the newly created llm bindings

post.description: Registers a new LLM provider configuration (e.g., API URL, authentication secrets, and model parameters). Why: This separates external provider-specific parameters from cognitive agent definitions, enabling administrators to swap backend engines, rotate keys, or adjust latency thresholds globally without affecting individual agent templates.

get.summary: List all LLM provider bindings
get.description: Retrieves a list of all registered LLM provider bindings for the active tenant. Why: Allows client applications and administration UIs to discover available LLM hosting environments for binding agent configurations.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific LLM provider binding by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The system-generated UUID of the LLM provider binding to retrieve.

get.description: Fetches the detailed configuration of an LLM provider binding using its UUID. Why: Facilitates inspecting target API endpoints, default temperatures, and secret keys during agent configuration audits.

put.summary: Update an LLM provider binding by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the LLM provider binding to update.

put.description: Modifies an existing LLM provider configuration by UUID. Why: Allows administrators to change models, update gateway URLs, or switch credential references when LLM infrastructure migrates, without interrupting running agents.

delete.summary: Delete an LLM provider binding by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the LLM provider binding to delete.

delete.description: Deletes a registered LLM provider binding by UUID. Why: Removes obsolete or insecure provider configurations from the system. Caution: This operation will fail if active agent configurations still reference this binding.

post.summary: Register a new MCP server profile

Location.description: The URI of the newly created mcp servers

post.description: Registers a new Model Context Protocol (MCP) server profile, defining transport mechanism (stdio subprocess or SSE stream) and environmental arguments. Why: Registers external tool bundles globally, providing a catalog of secure adapters that agents can attach to for external filesystem, API, or database operations.

get.summary: List registered MCP server profiles
get.description: Lists all registered MCP server profiles accessible to the active tenant. Why: Enables visual catalogs to show what integrations are available for mounting onto autonomous agent nodes.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific MCP server profile by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the MCP server configuration profile.

get.description: Retrieves complete transport and command parameters of an MCP server by UUID. Why: Supports detail rendering and tool mapping when auditing agent capability mounts.

put.summary: Update an MCP server profile by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the MCP server configuration to update.

put.description: Modifies the execution command, transport, SSE URL, or secrets of an MCP profile by UUID. Why: Supports hot-updating tool server profiles when microservices upgrade or command arguments evolve.

delete.summary: Unregister an MCP server profile by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the MCP server configuration to delete.

delete.description: Removes an MCP server profile from the global registry. Why: Deprecates integration tools that are no longer supported or secure. Enforces constraint validation to ensure no active agent blueprints are left referencing this server.

Location.description: The URI of the newly created skills

post.description: Registers a new discrete capability skill containing guidelines and content prompts. Why: Standardizes unique capability rules (e.g. 'code-review-standards') so they can be reused and enforced within various agent prompts.

get.summary: List all Skills
get.description: Lists all registered capability skills defined for the active tenant. Why: Provides a lookup repository of individual behavioral guidelines.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific Skill by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Skill capability to retrieve.

get.description: Retrieves the content rules and metadata of a registered skill by UUID. Why: Audits the exact prompts injected into active LLM systems.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Skill capability to update.

put.description: Updates the natural language content or description of a skill by UUID. Why: Enables rapid tuning of agent boundaries and safety behaviors without modifying the agent blueprints directly.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Skill capability to delete.

delete.description: Removes a skill definition by UUID. Why: Cleans up obsolete behavioral directives.

post.summary: Attach a Skill to an Agent

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Agent template.

parameters.name: skill_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Skill capability to attach.

post.description: Mounts a specific skill capability onto an agent template. Why: Authorizes the agent to incorporate the skill's guidelines, behaviors, and constraints into its cognitive prompt chain.

delete.summary: Detach a Skill from an Agent

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Agent template.

parameters.name: skill_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Skill capability to detach.

delete.description: Removes a mounted skill capability from an agent template. Why: Revokes the agent's access to specific guidelines or tool constraints.

Location.description: The URI of the newly created skill collections

post.description: Creates a named folder of linked skill UUIDs. Why: Bundles related capability skills into a single logical package, allowing users to easily attach multi-skill roles to agent templates at once.

get.summary: List all Skill Collections
get.description: Lists all skill collections registered for the tenant. Why: Enables discovery of standardized capability role profiles.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific Skill Collection by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Skill Collection to retrieve.

get.description: Retrieves a skill collection template listing its linked skill UUIDs by UUID. Why: Inspects the membership of standard capability bundles.

put.summary: Update a Skill Collection by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Skill Collection to update.

put.description: Updates the metadata or linked skill membership array of a collection by UUID. Why: Allows rolling out new behavioral modifications or tools globally across all agents consuming this collection bundle.

delete.summary: Delete a Skill Collection by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Skill Collection to delete.

delete.description: Deletes a skill collection container by UUID. Why: Dissolves standard bundle envelopes. Note: This does not delete the underlying skills themselves.

get.summary: Resolve all nested skills in a collection

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Skill Collection to compile and resolve.

get.description: Queries a collection and returns the fully hydrated, flattened list of all Skills inside. Why: Resolves hierarchical capability graphs, providing the downstream runtime or compiler with the complete set of natural language system prompt instructions to serve the agent's LLM.

Location.description: The URI of the newly created prompts

post.description: Registers a reusable system prompt instruction or dialog template. Why: Inserts cognitive, framing, or reasoning prompts into the centralized prompt store.

get.summary: List all Prompt Templates
get.description: Lists all registered system and user prompt templates defined in the system. Why: Facilitates reusing versioned instructions across multiple agent models.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific Prompt Template by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Prompt Template to retrieve.

get.description: Retrieves the raw text and lifecycle state of a prompt template by UUID. Why: Evaluates the system directives deployed inside active cognitive networks.

put.summary: Update a Prompt Template by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Prompt Template to update.

200.description: Successfully updated and created a new Prompt Template version

put.description: Modifies prompt content, labels, or draft status by UUID. Why: Enables prompt engineers to fine-tune instructions, inject safety blocks, or update formatting schemas in real-time.

delete.summary: Delete a Prompt Template by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Prompt Template to delete.

delete.description: Removes a prompt template from the registry by UUID. Why: Retires obsolete instruction sets.

Location.description: The URI of the newly created prompt collections

post.description: Groups multiple prompt templates into a unified bundle. Why: Represents a comprehensive dialogue flow or complete cognitive context package ready for agent attachment.

get.summary: List all Prompt Collections
get.description: Lists all prompt collections registered in the system. Why: Identifies standard dialog configurations.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific Prompt Collection by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Prompt Collection to retrieve.

get.description: Retrieves a prompt collection's templates map by UUID. Why: Inspects the instructional structure of dynamic agent workflows.

put.summary: Update a Prompt Collection by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Prompt Collection to update.

put.description: Updates prompt collection metadata or its linked templates array by UUID. Why: Facilitates version upgrades to the dialogue instructions of active agent teams.

delete.summary: Delete a Prompt Collection by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Prompt Collection to delete.

delete.description: Deletes a prompt collection profile by UUID. Why: Cleans up deprecated dialog blueprints.

get.summary: Resolve all templates in a collection

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Prompt Collection to resolve.

get.description: Compiles and flattens a prompt collection into a fully hydrated array of prompt contents. Why: Provides the runtime container with the complete, compiled instructional payload needed to build the cognitive engine context before execution.

Location.description: The URI of the newly created agents

post.description: Creates an Agent template configuration. Why: Registers the full architectural template (brain, memory parameters, prompts, skills, and tool clients) in the database, establishing the blueprint before physical container rollout.

get.summary: List all Agent templates
get.description: Lists all agent configurations defined within the active tenant domain. Why: Provides a catalog of agent personas and templates defined in the system.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific Agent template by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the agent template

get.description: Retrieves the complete configuration block of an agent template using its UUID. Why: Inspects cognitive configurations, tool mounts, and memory policies of an agent prior to deployment.

put.summary: Update an Agent template by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the agent template

put.description: Updates an agent's brain configuration, memory targets, attached skills, or mounted MCP clients. Why: Adjusts cognitive blueprints or capabilities. Note: If the agent is actively deployed, these updates will require a redeployment to reconcile the runtime state.

delete.summary: Delete an Agent template by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the agent template

delete.description: Deletes an agent configuration blueprint from the database by UUID. Why: Cleans up obsolete blueprints. Caution: This operation will reject if the agent is actively deployed in a Kubernetes cluster or assigned to a community.

post.summary: Create a new Community network boundary

Location.description: The URI of the newly created communities

post.description: Creates a logical community network boundary with a designated topology (e.g. hub-spoke). Why: Establishes a secure communication namespace and isolation group where agents can collaborate and exchange events via the NATS message broker.

get.summary: List all Communities
get.description: Lists all community network boundaries registered under the active tenant domain. Why: Enables looking up collaborative environments and auditing logical network segments.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific Community by ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Community

get.description: Retrieves the topology, status, and custom variables of a community by UUID. Why: Audits logical routing policies and configurations for multi-agent networking.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Community

put.description: Updates community metadata, topology types, or dynamic variables by UUID. Why: Manages structural changes to networking scopes or custom parameters of collaboration zones.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Community

delete.description: Removes a community network registry from the database. Why: Deprecates active collaboration zones. Note: Rejects if the community has active agents assigned.

post.summary: Assign an Agent to a Community

parameters.name: community_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Community network boundary.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Agent template to assign.

post.description: Binds an agent template to a specific community network boundary. Why: Binds the agent's event routes to the community's communication mesh and sets the `community_id` foreign key. Crucial step before deploying the agent, ensuring it wakes up in a secure, isolated workspace.

delete.summary: Unassign an Agent from a Community

parameters.name: community_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Community network boundary.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Agent to unassign.

delete.description: Clears an agent's association with a community, returning its status to standalone 'defined'. Why: Revokes community event membership. Caution: This operation requires the agent to be undeployed first.

get.summary: Retrieve an Agent's A2A AgentCard

parameters.name: community_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Community.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Agent.

get.description: Retrieves the A2A AgentCard containing capabilities, default modes, and skills of the specified agent in the community.

get.summary: Retrieve a Community's collective CommunityCard

parameters.name: community_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Community.

get.description: Retrieves the collective metadata and active member summaries of the community.

get.summary: List active AgentCards in a Community

parameters.name: community_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Community.

get.description: Retrieves a lightweight index of all active AgentCards inside the community.

post.summary: Deploy an Agent to the runtime environment

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Agent template to deploy.

post.description: Translates the database agent blueprint into a live Kubernetes deployment (TacitoAgent CRD) and signals the operator to spawn the container pod. Why: Transitions the agent from a static configuration into an active, running, autonomous cognitive subprocess capable of processing workflows.

post.summary: Undeploy an Agent and terminate its runtime

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Agent to undeploy.

post.description: Tears down the TacitoAgent Kubernetes CRD and terminates the agent container pod. Why: Safely stops execution, clean-releases NATS listeners, and frees infrastructure resources while preserving the database configuration template intact.

get.summary: Query active Agent runtime status

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the deployed Agent.

get.description: Queries the live Kubernetes status fields of the deployed agent pod (reconciling container states, replicas, memory limits, and operator errors). Why: Provides live observability and health reporting for control panels and monitoring dashboards.

post.summary: Deploy a Community and all its assigned agents

parameters.name: community_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Community to deploy.

post.description: Triggers sequential or parallel deployment for every single agent assigned to the community. Why: Orchestrates rolling out a complete multi-agent collaborative workspace in one transaction, ensuring all team members are booted and interconnected.

post.summary: Undeploy a Community and teardown all its agents

parameters.name: community_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Community to undeploy.

post.description: Stops runtime execution for the entire community. Tears down all agent container pods and NATS routing meshes. Why: Safely suspends a collaborative workspace in one step, saving cluster resources.

get.summary: Query live Community and agent runtime status

parameters.name: community_id
parameters.description: The UUID of the Community to query.

get.description: Aggregates live Kubernetes operational health, replica counts, and pod errors for all agents assigned to the community. Why: Offers high-level observability indicating if the entire multi-agent mesh is healthy and ready to process workflows.

post.description: Accepts a schemaRef and payload, dynamically resolves routing subjects and tenant ID, sanitizes message contents, auto-populates system metadata, and broadcasts the completed DomainEvent onto the NATS network.

get.summary: Subscribe to real-time events stream (SSE)
get.description: Establishes a persistent Server-Sent Events (SSE) connection. Subscribes to the NATS community wildcard events filtered by the client's resolved tenant context, fanning out live conversational updates.

api_base_url.description: The API endpoint URL. Why: Directs the outgoing HTTP client to the specific inference gateway.

api_key_secret_ref.description: Secret reference containing the provider's API key. Why: Ensures secure credential resolution.

default_temperature.description: Default sampling temperature. Why: Defines creativity boundaries when not overridden by specific agents.

default_max_tokens.description: Default maximum token limit. Why: Prevents infinite response loops and controls cost metrics.

timeout_seconds.description: API request timeout in seconds. Why: Enforces clean deadlines to prevent backend thread starvation.

CreateLLMBindingRequest.description: Request payload to create a new LLM provider binding. Why: Standardizes the input parameters needed to connect to an external inference endpoint.

description.description: Updated description indicating the SLA or hosting zone of the endpoint.

api_base_url.description: The target API gateway endpoint URL.

api_key_secret_ref.description: Reference to the updated API credentials secret.

UpdateLLMBindingRequest.description: Request payload to update an existing LLM provider binding. Why: Allows updating endpoints, model overrides, or secret references without changing associated agent models.

id.description: System-generated unique UUID. Why: Uniquely identifies this LLM binding resource throughout the keeper.

name.description: Unique registration name referenced by agent templates.

description.description: Detailed explanation of the binding's role and purpose.

provider.description: LLM provider type which dictates client library selection.

api_base_url.description: The resolved target HTTP gateway URL.

api_key_secret_ref.description: Pointer to the credentials stored within secure backend secrets.

default_model.description: Standard model string used for fallbacks.

status.description: Active deployment status. Why: Allows administrators to temporarily suspend specific models.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this LLM binding was registered.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last binding configuration update.

LLMBinding.description: Represents a registered LLM provider binding. Why: Stores the configuration for a specific LLM hosting service, separating the physical integration layer from the cognitive agent templates.

name.description: Unique profile name for this MCP server. Why: Allows agent blueprints to link this server.

description.description: Purpose of the MCP server, detailing what tools and capabilities it exposes.

env.description: Environmental variables. Why: Securely configures target credentials, debug toggles, or ports for the subprocess.

url.description: External Server-Sent Events stream endpoint. Why: Required for SSE transport to locate the remote listener.

auth_secret_ref.description: Secret pointer containing target API keys. Why: Authenticates remote HTTP connection flows.

CreateMCPServerRequest.description: Request payload to register a new Model Context Protocol (MCP) server profile. Why: Specifies how the orchestrator should boot and connect to a tool-exposing server.

name.description: Updated profile name for the MCP server.

description.description: Updated explanation of the tool collection scope.

UpdateMCPServerRequest.description: Request payload to update an MCP server profile. Why: Allows modifying commands, environmental arguments, or URLs when MCP servers relocate or upgrade.

name.description: Unique profile identifier used by agent templates.

description.description: Brief description of the server's function.

command.description: Path of the executed binary for local stdio integration.

args.description: Array of command-line arguments passed at startup.

env.description: Key-value map of runtime environment configurations.

url.description: The remote HTTP SSE endpoint URL.

status.description: Lifecycle state of this MCP connection configuration.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this MCP server profile was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last configuration update.

MCPServer.description: Stores the profile of a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server. Why: Serves as the database record detailing the transport protocols, runtime execution commands, and security configurations for external tools.

name.description: Unique skill name. Why: Allows identifying the skill in search results and attaching it to templates.

description.example: Google search and URL extraction tools

content.example: Always verify calculation steps before outputting final answers.

CreateSkillRequest.description: Request payload to create a new behavioral capability or skill. Why: Enables injecting specific business rules and guidelines into the system.

name.description: Unique skill identifier name.

description.example: Google search and URL extraction tools
description.description: Refined summary of the capability scope.

content.example: Always verify calculation steps before outputting final answers.

UpdateSkillRequest.description: Request payload to update a skill's content or description. Why: Allows refining the behavioral constraints of an active skill dynamically.

name.description: Human-readable label mapping to this specific skill capability.

description.description: Explanation of what tasks or rules this skill handles.

content.description: Natural language instructions guiding agent decision-making policies.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this skill was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last skill modification.

Skill.description: Represents a distinct capability skill containing domain behavior constraints. Why: Defines the specific operational rules and guidelines an agent must follow for a feature area.

name.description: Unique collection name. Why: Allows attaching this bundle to agents directly.

description.description: Purpose of this collection, listing what roles or teams use these capabilities.

skills.description: List of UUIDs representing member skills. Why: Aggregates modular skills into a single management unit.

CreateSkillCollectionRequest.description: Request payload to bundle multiple skills into a collection. Why: Simplifies binding standard skillsets to agents in bulk.

name.description: Unique collection name.

description.description: Updated explanation of the collection's role.

skills.description: Updated list of UUIDs defining this collection's skills.

UpdateSkillCollectionRequest.description: Request payload to update a skill collection's members. Why: Allows adding or removing modular capabilities across all consuming agents simultaneously.

name.description: Unique skillset bundle label.

description.description: Summary explaining the skillset bundle's function.

skills.description: Array of skill UUIDs linked into this collection.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the collection was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last collection membership change.

SkillCollection.description: Groups multiple Skill references into a single logical capability set. Why: Enables robust multi-agent template definition without listing individual skills redundantly.

name.description: Unique name for the prompt template. Why: Enables identification and version tracking.

content.example: You are a helpful AI assistant.
content.description: The actual instruction template string. Why: Defines the core personality and structure of model outputs.

status.description: Initial status of the template. Why: Allows draft mode workflows prior to staging/production rollouts.

CreatePromptTemplateRequest.description: Request payload to define a new versioned system instruction template. Why: Inserts cognitive directives or framing rules into the prompt engineering store.

name.description: Unique template identifier name.

content.example: You are a helpful AI assistant version 2.

status.description: New lifecycle status (e.g. moving draft to active, or archiving older versions).

UpdatePromptTemplateRequest.description: Request payload to update a prompt template and modify its lifecycle status. Why: Allows prompt engineers to iterate on agent personality, safety guardrails, and formatting.

name.description: Unique template name.

content.description: The natural language instruction string served to the models.

status.description: Current lifecycle state of the template.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when this template was created.

PromptTemplate.description: Represents a versioned prompt pattern or instruction. Why: Stores the actual natural language instructions that guide LLM reasoning and behavior.

name.description: Unique prompt collection name. Why: Linked directly into the agent template parameters.

description.example: A collection of greeting and behavioral templates.
description.description: Functional description of the collection's role (e.g. 'Standard Coding Agents Collection').

templates.description: List of UUIDs mapping member templates. Why: Collects individual behavioral directives into a unified packet.

CreatePromptCollectionRequest.description: Request payload to assemble multiple prompt templates. Why: Prepares cohesive sets of system, user, and safety prompts for agent instantiation.

name.description: Unique prompt collection name.

description.example: A collection of greeting and behavioral templates.
description.description: Updated collection description details.

templates.description: Updated list of linked prompt template UUIDs.

UpdatePromptCollectionRequest.description: Request payload to update prompt collection template links. Why: Coordinates major upgrades to the multi-turn prompt templates used by active agents.

name.description: Unique prompt bundle name.

description.description: Functional scope overview for the collection.

templates.description: Array of linked prompt template UUIDs.

created_at.description: Timestamp indicating when the collection was initialized.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last prompt collection update.

PromptCollection.description: Aggregates a set of versioned prompt templates into a unified collection. Why: Simplifies referencing entire dialog structures or instruction sets from the agent configuration.

error.description: Descriptive error message. Why: Explains validation syntax failures or database unavailable causes.

ErrorResponse.description: Standardized API error response container. Why: Enforces consistent error handling across the entire system, strictly matching the Spec NFR constraints.

model.description: Target LLM model string (e.g. gpt-4o). Why: Tells the inference engine what architecture to query.

temperature.description: Model sampling temperature. Why: Determines predictability vs creativity of generated content.

max_tokens.description: Token output limit. Why: Sets strict usage boundaries to avoid cascading latency or processing costs.

endpoint.description: Direct model endpoint URL override. Why: Allows bypassing the standard binding URL for private test proxies.

credentials_secret.description: Secret ref containing access tokens. Why: Authenticates outbound calls securely.

BrainConfig.description: Defines the agent's cognitive brain. Why: Selects the LLM provider, target model, and parameters (like temperature) that govern agent reasoning.

key_namespace.description: Prefix string for Redis keys. Why: Isolates data namespaces between distinct sessions or agents.

ttl_seconds.description: Lifespan of session keys in seconds. Why: Automatically reclaims Redis memory when conversations terminate.

ShortTermMemoryConfig.description: Configuration for the agent's conversational runtime memory. Why: Standardizes Redis key namespaces and TTL policies to clean up inactive session histories automatically.

collection_name.description: Target Qdrant vector database collection. Why: Segregates vector storage namespaces for security.

vector_dimension.description: Embedding vector dimensions. Why: Ensures the vector collection aligns with the LLM's encoder dimensions.

LongTermMemoryConfig.description: Configuration for semantic vector database memory. Why: Links the agent to high-dimensional knowledge retrieval collections in Qdrant.

server_id.description: UUID reference of the registered MCP server profile. Why: Identifies which tool server should be mounted.

custom_env.description: Runtime environment overrides. Why: Tailors MCP server execution variables dynamically for this agent.

custom_args.description: Launch arguments overrides. Why: Adjusts the tool mounting paths or parameters for individual agents.

MCPClientConfig.description: Configuration for mounting a specific MCP server onto an agent. Why: Governs which MCP tool servers are activated and parameterizes client-side overrides.

name.description: Unique name of the agent. Why: Uniquely identifies the autonomous agent template.

description.description: Role description for this agent, highlighting its expertise area.

role.description: Topology role of the agent. Why: Distinguishes routing hubs from specialist spokes.

skills.description: Optional array of Skill or SkillCollection UUIDs. Why: Endows the agent with specific operational tools.

prompt_template.description: UUID pointing to a specific PromptTemplate. Why: Formulates the agent's core instructions.

mcp_clients.description: Array of MCP client configurations. Why: Enables the agent to execute specific external tools.

tier.description: Logical runtime tier name (e.g. 'standard', 'heavy', 'gpu-optimized'). The Operator maps this to container resources and image settings. If omitted or unknown, the implicit default profile is used.

deployment.description: Deployment configuration options. Why: Decouples infrastructure sizing from the agent definition, allowing operators to define resource profiles independently.

CreateAgentRequest.description: Request payload to define an Agent template. Why: Packages the cognitive blueprint (LLM, memory policies, skills, prompts, and tool attachments) for creation.

mcp_clients.description: Updated array of mounted MCP server configurations.

tier.description: Updated logical runtime tier name. Operator will apply the new tier profile on the next reconciliation after agent reassignment.

UpdateAgentRequest.description: Request payload to modify an existing Agent template. Why: Supports hot-updating memory policies, prompt templates, or skill configurations.

name.description: Unique agent identifier label.

description.description: Explanation of the agent's functional role.

long_term_memory.description: Active long term vector database memory configs.

skills.description: Array of skill UUIDs currently attached to this agent.

prompt_template.description: Active prompt template UUID pointer guiding reasoning.

mcp_clients.description: Array of active MCP client mounts providing tools.

status.description: Operational state. Why: Distinguishes defined templates from actively assigned or running agents.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this agent blueprint was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last agent metadata change.

community_id.description: UUID of the assigned community. Why: Null if unassigned; binds the agent to a secure logical network domain.

tier.description: Logical runtime tier name assigned to this agent (empty string if using the implicit default).

Agent.description: Blueprint configuration of an autonomous agent. Why: Serves as the authoritative source of truth detailing the cognitive architecture of an agent model.

name.description: Unique community name. Why: Uniquely identifies the network domain.

description.description: Context of the community, detailing what workflows or teams operate inside.

topology.description: Collaboration structure. Why: Single standalone or Hub-Spoke layout.

configuration.description: Dynamic JSON configuration overrides. Why: Customizes network latency, ports, or NATS topics.

CreateCommunityRequest.description: Request payload to create a new logical community boundary. Why: Instantiates isolated networking contexts and communication topologies for collaboration.

name.description: Updated unique community name.

description.description: Refined workflow explanation.

status.description: Updated lifecycle status of the community.

UpdateCommunityRequest.description: Request payload to update a community's metadata or status. Why: Manages active state transitions or adjustments to collaboration topologies.

tenant_id.description: Dynamic isolation key. Why: Enforces multitenancy so database queries automatically filter tenant scope.

name.description: Unique community network domain name.

description.description: Workflow context description for the community.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the community was initialized.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last community topology modification.

Community.description: Represents a logical networking boundary and agent collaboration domain. Why: Enforces tenancy isolation and structures horizontal message routing rules.

agent_id.description: Target agent UUID. Why: Identifies which autonomous unit this status report describes.

status.description: Live pod scheduling state resolved from Kubernetes (e.g. running, pending, failed).

message.description: Status description message. Why: Returns descriptive crash errors or startup progress logs.

replicas.description: Number of live container instances actively executing in Kubernetes.

updated_at.description: Timestamp of the last Kubernetes status reconcile.

AgentStatusDetails.description: Detailed operational and deployment status of a runtime agent container. Why: Directs Kubernetes pod replica states, health statuses, and failure logs back to the control plane.

agent_id.description: UUID of the targeted agent resource.

status.description: Result of the scheduling deployment (e.g. success, failed, pending).

error.description: Detailed error log. Why: Null on success; records orchestrator scheduling failures.

AgentDeploymentResult.description: Details the results of a single agent's deployment process. Why: Reports scheduling success or underlying container provisioning errors back to the caller.

community_id.description: Target community UUID. Why: Pinpoints the collaboration domain this report covers.

status.description: Consolidated deployment state of the entire community rollout.

agents.description: Rollout report array listing deployment details for every assigned agent.

CommunityDeploymentDetails.description: Deployment summary report for all agents inside a community. Why: Offers a single transactional view indicating the rollout status of a multi-agent team.

status.description: Consolidated live operational status of the community.

agents.description: Array listing live operational and container statuses for all assigned agents.

CommunityStatusDetails.description: Live operational monitoring status of all agents assigned to a community. Why: Facilitates observability by aggregating live replica counts and error messages from Kubernetes CRD status blocks.

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for this event instance.

schema_ref.description: Versioned URN identifying the event's payload schema.

source.description: Identifier of the component that emitted the event.

occurred_at.description: UTC timestamp when the event was created.

DomainEvent.description: Canonical, schema-agnostic event envelope used throughout the reactive mesh.
